Synopsis:
This dialog replaces EA version in Gustav mod!After the goblin hunt celebration party, this companion has made arrangements to get intimate with the player at night. Note: this can only happen if player already knows about Mizora

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_GoblinHuntTieflingCelebration_CRD_ROM_Wyll_PostEA.json: The scene takes place at the camp after a successful goblin‑hunt celebration; most companions are still partying while Wyll has slipped away to brood. Off‑screen he’s already made private arrangements to be intimate with the player that night (this scene only appears if the player already knows about Mizora). Wyll’s mood is somber and duty‑bound — he worries the group still faces dangers (he even names Karlach) and doesn’t want to cast a pall over the festivities. His lines mix self‑mocking gallantry with genuine concern, so the player’s invitations shift the moment from grim reflection back toward warmth and flirtation.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_SD_ROM_NightWithShadowheart.json: After the goblin hunt celebration party, this companion has made arrangements to get intimate with the player at night.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_SC_NightWithLaezel.json: After the goblin hunt celebration party, this companion has made arrangements to get intimate with the player at night.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntTieflingCelebration_CRD_Astarion.json: After the party, Astarion is standing in a corner, bottle of wine in hand, in a bad mood. Everything's too merry for him, not hedonistic enough. But there's the possibility of a little hedonism with the player, if you both agree to meet up for a little 'fun' later in the night. That's a tantilising thought - there might be something to look forward to after all.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_UnfortunateGnome.json: Unfortunate gnome's dialog after the goblin hunt celebration party. There are actually two different dialoues: one for when the player sided with the goblins, in which he is pissed off at the player and ready to leave, and one where the player sided with the tieflings, in which he is happy for them, but doesn't want to partake in the celebrations himself, since it has nothing to do with him, and he wants to go save his friend as soon as possible. In this case, he's standing next to a workbench, working on making explosive arrows (ARR_Arrow_Of_Fire).

context: After the goblin‑hunt celebration at camp, most companions are still partying while Wyll has slipped away to brood. Off‑screen he has already made private arrangements to be intimate with the player later that night — this scene only appears if the player already knows about Mizora. Wyll is somber and duty‑bound, worried the group still faces dangers (he even names Karlach) and doesn’t want to cast a grey cloud over the festivities. His lines mix self‑mocking gallantry with genuine concern, so the player’s teasing or reassuring replies (or asking him to dance) can turn his mood from grim reflection toward warmth and flirtation.
